images.name: enterprise-pillars
images.prompt: Use case: infographic-diagram. Generate a polished landscape educational raster infographic for an enterprise architecture website, approximately 1600x1000. Match the supplied context-pipeline example's visual language: warm ivory paper background, bold black heading, deep teal headings and icons, orange highlights, subtle dimensional paper cards and shadows, fine dotted connectors, meaningful vector clouds, careful whitespace. Rich visual explanation, not a set of text boxes. Large readable labels, no tiny paragraphs, no logos, no decorative robot or brain. Correct spelling. Use only the requested labels. This is conceptual illustration, not measured data. Title: 'BUILD AN AGENTIC ENTERPRISE'. Show a coherent architectural scene: a wide foundation labelled 'Enterprise architecture' with icons of systems, people, tools and controls. Above it two substantial complementary structures labelled 'INTELLIGENCE' and 'MEMORY'. Intelligence holds task cards, a model symbol and a tool-loop mechanism, labels 'Understand', 'Investigate', 'Act within limits'. Memory holds documents, image thumbnails, terrain map tiles and waveforms linked to searchable point clouds and cited source cards, labels 'Find', 'Verify', 'Cite'. Both feed a central business outcome card 'Useful work, verified results'. Below intelligence put 'Enough capability at an acceptable cost'. Below memory put 'Evidence you can trace to its source'. Make the relationship of architecture supporting these two pillars visually unmistakable. No numeric maturity scale.

images.name: evidence-organization
images.prompt: Use case: infographic-diagram. Generate a polished landscape educational raster infographic for an enterprise architecture website, approximately 1600x1000. Match the supplied context-pipeline example's visual language: warm ivory paper background, bold black heading, deep teal headings and icons, orange highlights, subtle dimensional paper cards and shadows, fine dotted connectors, meaningful vector clouds, careful whitespace. Rich visual explanation, not a set of text boxes. Large readable labels, no tiny paragraphs, no logos, no decorative robot or brain. Correct spelling. Use only the requested labels. This is conceptual illustration, not measured data. Title: 'FROM MEMORY TO EVIDENCE FOR A DECISION'. A richly illustrated, coherent five-part horizontal pipeline similar to the context-pipeline reference, with a return loop. Part 1 'Preserve sources': original manuals, work orders, photo, terrain tile, waveform. Part 2 'Represent for the question': parallel branches for exact record, text cloud, image cloud, map-feature cloud, sequence cloud. Keep clouds separate, not one universal space. Part 3 'Retrieve and check': asset identity key, clock for validity, access lock, source-version stamp; filter results through visible review gate. Part 4 'Assemble evidence': a case folder with anchored citations pointing all the way back to source items; one contradictory item remains visible marked 'Unresolved'. Part 5 'Record the decision': card with 'Evidence used', 'Reason', 'Approval', 'Outcome'. A lower return arrow 'Corrections and access changes' links sources to their derived indexes and retained evidence. Bottom 'Vectors help find evidence. The decision record points back to sources.' Make icons convey concepts densely and clearly, not tiny text-heavy cards; no claim that citation alone proves correctness.

edits.prompt: Edit this generated infographic, preserving its entire layout, illustrations, colors, typography, and all other words. Make exactly two corrections in stages 3 and 4: in the review-gate outputs replace the red X beside the map-pin icon with an amber question mark beside a PHOTO icon, because this is unresolved conflicting evidence, not evidence denied access. In the bottom highlighted row of the evidence folder replace the misspelled label with the exact words 'Conflicting evidence'. Preserve the 'Unresolved' badge. Do not add or remove any other content.
